tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Search the logs in an Elasticsearch or OpenSearch index pattern in a time range, newest first, with a Lucene query string such as level:error AND service.name:checkout. Returns each hit's index, ID and chosen fields, long values cut, the total number of matches, and a link to the search.

fields.description: The fields to return, such as service.name or kubernetes.*. The time and message fields are always returned. Default: the time and message fields and a few common ones such as log.level.

index.description: The index or index pattern to read, such as logs-*, one that Sidekick's config allows. It may be left out when Sidekick allows only one pattern.

limit.description: The most hits to return, 1 to 200. Default 50.

query.description: The Lucene query string, for example status:>=500 AND NOT path:"/healthz". Empty matches every log in the time range.

since.description: Only logs at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Required; the range may be at most 7 days.

until.description: Only logs before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: count_logs
tools.description: Count the logs in an Elasticsearch or OpenSearch index pattern that match a Lucene query string, in time buckets over a range, optionally split by the 10 most common values of one field. Shows when errors started or stopped, and which service or host they come from.

index.description: The index or index pattern to read, such as logs-*, one that Sidekick's config allows. It may be left out when Sidekick allows only one pattern.

interval.description: The length of one time bucket, in seconds. At most 200 buckets fit in the range. Default: about 60 buckets.

query.description: The Lucene query string, for example level:error. Empty counts every log.

since.description: The start of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Required; the range may be at most 7 days.

splitBy.description: A keyword field to split the counts by, such as service.name or host.name. list_fields says which fields are aggregatable.

until.description: The end of the range, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z. Default: now.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: List the fields of an Elasticsearch or OpenSearch index pattern with their types, and whether each can be searched and counted by, so queries name fields that exist.

fields.description: Only fields whose names match this pattern, such as kubernetes.* or *.name. Default: every field.

index.description: The index or index pattern to read, such as logs-*, one that Sidekick's config allows. It may be left out when Sidekick allows only one pattern.
